ai_summary: Accuracy Shipping Limited reported a substantial decline in Q2 and H1 FY24 revenue and EBITDA, primarily driven by a weak global economy and a dramatic collapse in freight rates that severely impacted its core logistics operations. While strong performance from its diversified heavy commercial vehicle (HCV) sales segment (31% of H1 revenue) provided some offset, the company exhibits very thin overall margins, with core logistics EBITDA margins around 1.78%. A key red flag is the increased revenue reliance on marble/granite (41% of H1) despite stated diversification efforts, coupled with significant exposure to volatile freight rates for future recovery.
